reason: Source VIS-FSV-B19-01 section 2.4 states that when a supplier is blocked with hold type 'Invoices' or 'All', ERPNext will not allow Purchase Orders to be created. It also states that if a hold type is not selected, ERPNext defaults to 'All'. Therefore, a Purchase Order creation request must be denied when trusted.supplierOnHold is true unless the trusted.holdType is strictly 'Payments'.
